claim_scope: Development-only, neutral closed-shell FreeSolv molecules in water; one frozen FreeSolv geometry per molecule; frozen AM1-BCC charges; APBS linearized Poisson-Boltzmann polar energy with a molecular dielectric surface; and the frozen OpenMM mbondi2/ACE nonpolar component. This evaluates a fixed-geometry, SP-energy-only continuum endpoint. It is not a sampled finite-temperature hydration free energy, a force-capable OPT/SCAN provider, broad-solvent validation, or independent confirmation.

decision.scope: SP energy only; APBS molecular-surface forces are not exposed.

interpretation: Development-only fixed-geometry comparison. APBS supplies only the molecular-surface LPBE polar term; the APBS APOLAR control and the OpenMM ACE candidate are mutually exclusive nonpolar endpoints. No gas-phase MLIP or MM energy enters the scored correction.

label_use_boundary.summary_phase: Experimental FreeSolv values read only after all energy and grid records existed.

selection_disclosure: The full development screen was commissioned after an exploratory aniline calculation suggested that replacing APBS APOLAR with ACE could help. The 526-molecule result is therefore development evidence and cannot be relabeled as independent confirmation.
